content.title: Offline count conflict handling
content.statement: The app will keep the most recent count and ask the grower to confirm which count is correct.
content.context: Conflicting offline counts caused the app to double batch counts when multiple growers counted the same bench.
content.rationale: To fix the failure where conflicting offline counts caused the app to double batch counts.
content.impacts: The app will display both counts and require grower confirmation, preventing double counting.

sources.excerpt: - Offline count conflicts: keep the most recent count and ask the grower to confirm.
Marc and Sofia agreed to replace that rule: the app now keeps the most recent count and shows both counts to the grower, who confirms which one is right.
Adding conflicting counts together failed in testing.
